Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ti-centered octahedra coordinated by six O neighbors, alongside Mg-centered octahedra with six O neighbors. Corner- and edge-sharing are observed between O-centered and Ti-centered octahedra, as well as between Ti-centered octahedra, while Mg–Ti octahedra share corners and edges. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites.
